title: WebGPU Cascaded Shadow Mapping in Rust and wgpu
description: Build cascaded shadow mapping in Rust and WebGPU with four 2048×2048 depth layers, practical frustum splits, orthographic light matrices, and nine-tap PCF.
imageAlt: Five colored teapots receding across a long floor, each casting a directional shadow under four-cascade WebGPU shadow mapping.
